newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three climbers killed in French Alps.
newsitem.headline: Three climbers killed in French Alps.

text.p: Rescuers on Tuesday found the bodies of three climbers who fell to their deaths in two separate accidents in the French Alps.
Rescuers said two French climbers roped together fell 300 metres (1,000 ft) on the 3,950-metre (13,000 ft) Pelvoux peak near Grenoble.
A German climber fell about 100 metres (330 ft) while coming down from the 4,100-metre (13,500 ft) Aiguille Verte, near Mont Blanc.
Rescuers did not name the victims.
More than 40 climbers and hikers have died in France this summer.
